content: {"like":["Values strong thematic messages (e.g., censorship, empowerment through art), appreciates faithful adaptations and emotional resonance in music and storytelling, enjoys visually appealing color palettes and well-shot cinematography, seeks character depth and realistic development, and prefers inclusive, diverse representation that impacts narrative."],"dislike":["Dislikes abrupt or jarring editing and perceived narrative gaps, finds poorly executed sexual content or tokenism offensive, criticizes weak character development and inconsistent production quality, rejects forced or superficial representation of race and gender, and is dissatisfied with disjointed or overly commercialized storytelling choices."]}
